arguments.cmd: cadcheck verify --help 2>&1 | head -30; echo ---; cadcheck export --help 2>&1 | head -30

result.stdout:
usage: cadcheck verify [-h] [--out-dir OUT_DIR] [--assembly]
                       [--requirements REQUIREMENTS]
                       scad

positional arguments:
  scad

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --out-dir OUT_DIR
  --assembly
  --requirements REQUIREMENTS
---
usage: cadcheck export [-h] [-D DEFINES] [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--part PART]
                       [--out-dir OUT_DIR]
                       scad

positional arguments:
  scad

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  -D DEFINES
  --timeout TIMEOUT
  --part PART
  --out-dir OUT_DIR
